_about: Vocabulario cerrado de la ficha v2. Jev compara fichas literalmente: todos los modelos usan exactamente estas palabras en kind, input, output, interaction y access.

kind.chat LLM: general assistant that follows instructions and holds conversations in text
kind.multimodal LLM: chat LLM that also reads images, audio or video as input
kind.coding LLM: LLM specialised in writing, editing and explaining code
kind.search LLM: LLM that answers with live web search and citations
kind.realtime voice: spoken conversation in real time, speech in and speech out
kind.audio generation: creates sound effects or general audio from a prompt
kind.audio classification: labels audio clips (emotion, speaker traits, sound events)
kind.speaker diarization: tells who spoke when in a recording
kind.text-to-image: creates images from a text prompt
kind.image editing: changes an existing image from instructions (inpainting, restyling, background removal)
kind.text-to-video: creates video from a text or image prompt
kind.image classification: assigns labels to a whole image
kind.object detection: finds and boxes objects in an image
kind.image segmentation: outlines regions or objects pixel by pixel
kind.depth estimation: estimates distance of each pixel from a single image
kind.image captioning: describes or answers questions about an image in text
kind.video understanding: classifies or describes what happens in a video
kind.OCR and documents: reads text, tables and layout from scanned pages, PDFs and forms
kind.text embedding: turns text into vectors for semantic search, clustering and similarity
kind.multimodal embedding: turns images and text into comparable vectors
kind.reranker: reorders search results by relevance to a query
kind.text classification: assigns labels to a piece of text (sentiment, topic, toxicity)
kind.zero-shot classification: labels text with categories chosen at run time, without training
kind.named entity recognition: finds names, places, drugs, diseases or other entities in text
kind.summarization: condenses long text into a short summary
kind.question answering: extracts an answer from a given document or table
kind.base language model: pretrained text encoder or small model meant to be fine-tuned, not used directly
kind.moderation and safety: flags harmful, unsafe or policy-violating content
kind.3D generation: creates 3D models from text or images
kind.time-series forecasting: predicts future values of numeric series
kind.biology and protein: models protein, DNA or other biological sequences and structures

interaction.chat and instructions: you describe what you want in natural language and it responds; handles open-ended requests and conversation
interaction.task model: does one fixed task: give it the input, get the output; no conversation or open-ended instructions
interaction.base model: needs fine-tuning: pretrained backbone; must be fine-tuned on your data or wrapped in a pipeline before it is useful in a product
interaction.embedding model: returns vectors, not text; used inside search, recommendation or clustering systems
